## Order placement

A customer fills in the order form and submits it; the order is created with the status open.

### Flow 1: Place an order

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  Customer->>Order form: enter quantity
  Order form->>Order service: submit order
  Order service-->>Customer: order created
```
